scope: Add and locally serve the AC One human, MuJoCo, and composited three-panel video on the demo web page
summary: A full-width RGB-to-MANO-to-EEF-to-AC One card was added after the two VDA cards in demo/index.html, and the local demo plus MP4 were verified over HTTP on port 8001.
evidence: demo/index.html passes Python HTMLParser parsing and git diff --check.
The card links the 192-frame, 1536x384, 24 FPS H.264 three-panel MP4 and its 1536x384 poster.
The card explicitly identifies human RGB, gray-background dual-X5 MuJoCo replay, and source-scene robot composite.
The card states that garment motion is inherited from the source rather than driven by simulated contact or cloth dynamics.
GET / contains the new card and HEAD /showcase/acone-human-sim-composite-comparison.mp4 returns HTTP 200 with Content-Length 1868345.
The static demo server is listening at 127.0.0.1:8001 because port 8000 is occupied by the existing video workbench.
lessons: A three-panel 4:1 video should use the existing featured class so it receives a full-width row.
Serving on port 8001 preserves the unrelated service already bound to port 8000.
limitations: The demo-page change and media remain local and have not been committed, pushed, or deployed.
The local HTTP server is temporary and will stop when its process or session ends.
next_actions: Review http://localhost:8001/ through VS Code port forwarding.
Commit and push only after explicit user approval.
